assumptions: All templates use the same Tiny-LPU core and host cycle models; only technology/template metadata differ.
Cycle-to-time conversion uses a nominal clock constraint, not a validated silicon Fmax.
Selecting a PDK does not automatically change modeled cycle counts or the nominal clock sweep.
The tile DIE_AREA is the complete boundary, not the area available exclusively for standard cells.
A template action target does not establish shuttle availability, price, or a submission deadline.
